name: OpenSSL 'Heartbleed'
defect: The TLS heartbeat handler copied a claimed payload length without checking it against the record, leaking up to 16 KiB of process memory. The vulnerable release is OpenSSL 1.0.1f; the fixed release is 1.0.1g (the CVE-2014-0160 fix release). The probe (src/hb.c) performs the exact historical exploit message sequence — ClientHello with the heartbeat extension, then the malformed heartbeat immediately after ServerHelloDone — against the linked library's own protocol code.

clean_control.expectation: no residual on any axis (with the handshake-only clean fixture, the vulnerable and fixed builds are byte-identical on exit and stderr)
